headline: Tawhid Hridoy scores highest individual Test score for Bangladesh
summary: The 25-year-old batsman hit an unbeaten 242 against West Indies in Sylhet, becoming the fourth Bangladeshi to score a double century in Test cricket.
details: Tawhid Hridoy smashed an unbeaten 242 runs in the first innings of the Test match against West Indies in Sylhet, setting a new record for the highest individual score by a Bangladeshi batsman in Test cricket.
Hridoy's monumental innings came when Bangladesh was struggling at 22 for 2. He anchored the team's recovery, helping them secure a 30-run lead in the first innings.
The 25-year-old batsman shared a critical partnership of 202 runs with Taijul Islam and Taskin Ahmed to steer the team out of trouble.
Hridoy was the only standout performer in the first innings, with the next highest score being Mushfiqur Rahim's 34 runs.
Reflecting on the achievement, Hridoy stated that scoring a double century had been a dream of his and expressed gratitude for achieving it sooner than expected.
He credited his teammates Taijul and Taskin for their support, which gave him the confidence to keep batting.
Currently playing his third Test match, Hridoy emphasized that his primary goal is to contribute to the team's needs regardless of the match situation.
caption:
An unbeaten 242! Tawhid Hridoy just rewrote the record books for Bangladesh Test cricket.

Tawhid Hridoy smashed an unbeaten 242 runs in the first innings of the Test match against West Indies in Sylhet, setting a new record for the highest individual score by a Bangladeshi batsman in Test cricket.

Hridoy's monumental innings came when Bangladesh was struggling at 22 for 2. He anchored the team's recovery, helping them secure a 30-run lead in the first innings.

The 25-year-old batsman shared a critical partnership of 202 runs with Taijul Islam and Taskin Ahmed to steer the team out of trouble.

Hridoy was the only standout performer in the first innings, with the next highest score being Mushfiqur Rahim's 34 runs.

Reflecting on the achievement, Hridoy stated that scoring a double century had been a dream of his and expressed gratitude for achieving it sooner than expected.

He credited his teammates Taijul and Taskin for their support, which gave him the confidence to keep batting.

Currently playing his third Test match, Hridoy emphasized that his primary goal is to contribute to the team's needs regardless of the match situation.

headline_marked: [[Explosions heard in southern Iran]] near strategic Strait of Hormuz
headline: Explosions heard in southern Iran near strategic Strait of Hormuz
summary: Reports of blasts on Qeshm Island and other southern areas emerge amid escalating tensions between the US and Iran.
details: Explosions were reported on Saturday evening in several areas of southern Iran, including Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian state television.
While state TV suggested the blasts might be linked to military activities, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported that two missiles struck Qeshm Island.
The Revolutionary Guards Navy stated that two oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines while attempting to pass through an unauthorized route in the strait.
The US military confirmed that its forces disabled a commercial vessel that attempted to violate a US blockade of Iran by firing at the ship's stern.
These incidents occur shortly after the US carried out limited strikes on the island and amid fears that the US could restart major combat operations.
Iran has repeatedly warned it would respond to new attacks by targeting US and Israeli assets in neighboring countries.
caption:
Explosions rock southern Iran and oil tankers catch fire in the Strait of Hormuz as US-Iran tensions peak.

Explosions were reported on Saturday evening in several areas of southern Iran, including Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian state television.

While state TV suggested the blasts might be linked to military activities, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported that two missiles struck Qeshm Island.

The Revolutionary Guards Navy stated that two oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines while attempting to pass through an unauthorized route in the strait.

The US military confirmed that its forces disabled a commercial vessel that attempted to violate a US blockade of Iran by firing at the ship's stern.

These incidents occur shortly after the US carried out limited strikes on the island and amid fears that the US could restart major combat operations.

Iran has repeatedly warned it would respond to new attacks by targeting US and Israeli assets in neighboring countries.
